scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration is exhaustive; complete acyclic Hasse matching and primitive integer cycle/orbit bases independently checked. Exact integral equivariant Alexander duality under the ambient orientation character is applied. No independent external audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the 3-by-3 Cartesian square grid at threshold four; integral D4 homology modules, not an equivariant homotopy type or a general grid theorem. Previously tabulated rank four and its nonequivariant homotopy implication are expressly excluded from the novelty claim. Other unindexed equivalent work cannot be ruled out.
title: Integral dihedral homology modules of the nine-vertex four-robust grid and its total-cut dual
